oneOf.title: Inactive Timeout
oneOf.description: Specifies the period of inactivity, in seconds, after which the deployment will be automatically deactivated if no incoming requests are received. While deactivated, the deployment incurs no charges. When a request is sent to a deactivated deployment, it will be reactivated to process the request; this reactivation process typically introduces a delay of approximately 8 to 20 minutes before the deployment becomes fully operational.

oneOf.title: Schedule
oneOf.description: Specifies the schedule which the engine will be deployed with deployments (if existing on the engine).

timezone.description: The IANA timezone for the schedule

start_time.description: The start time for the schedule in HH:MM format

end_time.description: The end time for the schedule in HH:MM format

days.description: The days of the week for the schedule
